name: Japan Transcity Corporation
summary: Japan Transcity Corporation engages in logistics business in Japan and internationally. The company offers warehousing, port transportation, custom brokerage, sport facility management, and vehicle maintenance, as well as property trade, lease, and management services. It is also involved in cargo transportation by automobiles; consigned freight forwarding; international multi modal transport; power generation and electrical supply; containers, pallets, other transport equipment, and material handling equipment trade and lease; and other related businesses.
